== Description ==

Group photograph of attendees with lightsabers at the [[2025 World Championship]]. Front row, kneeling, left to right: [[Chris Wirfs]] (floral shirt), [[Anthony Howard]] (blue hoodie, Dodgers cap), [[Scott Lingrell]] (navy Union jersey), [[Jeff Lavigne]] (maroon T-shirt), [[Robbie Hendon]] (grey SWCCG cap), [[Casey Anis]] (grey jacket), [[Jordan Gosiaco]] (brown shirt) and [[Daniel Amor]] (navy shirt). Standing: [[Greg Shaw]] (red Phillies hoodie, far left), [[Mike Kessling]] (blue New Allies T-shirt), [[Brian Fred]] (behind Kessling, grey beard and glasses), [[Sam Tashima]] (grey polo, glasses), [[Steve Harpster]] (back row centre, white hair), [[AJ Hatoum]] (black T-shirt, glasses), [[Brandon Baity]] (grey-green jacket, green lightsaber), [[Karl Koenig]] (back row, red jacket over a yellow T-shirt), [[Randy Scott]] (Tatooine T-shirt, black cap), [[Joe Olson]] (grey T-shirt, lightsaber), [[Ming Huo]] (grey T-shirt, lightsaber) and [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (back row right, beard). Remaining faces unlabeled.
